authority_roles.scope: Medi-Cal managed-care contract and program authority

authority_roles.scope: County Organized Health System managed-care plan for Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo counties

authority_roles.name: Medi-Cal Rx / DHCS and contracted administrator
authority_roles.scope: Prescription pharmacy benefit administration; verify current vendor and operational route

authority_roles.name: CenCal Pharmacy Services
authority_roles.scope: Medical-pharmacy management for applicable physician-administered drugs billed through the medical or institutional benefit

responsibility_cards.issue: Previously authorized medication / continuity of care
responsibility_cards.benefit_category: identify pharmacy versus medical benefit before routing
responsibility_cards.responsible_department: CenCal Pharmacy Services for applicable medical-pharmacy issues; Medi-Cal Rx route for prescription pharmacy benefit
responsibility_cards.required_action: Verify prior authorization and treatment status, identify benefit owner, review continuation or transition requirements, notify the member/provider, and arrange service or provide applicable rights
responsibility_cards.time_limit: source-specific; capture the applicable continuity-of-care or expedited-review deadline
responsibility_cards.provider_contact: verify current provider contact and extension
responsibility_cards.escalation: responsible plan department → CenCal Health grievance/appeal pathway → DHCS or other applicable authority
responsibility_cards.appeal_or_grievance: verify current notice, grievance, appeal, and State Fair Hearing pathway
